description: Kenneth I. Gordon Massachusetts State Representative 21st Middlesex District February 13, 2025 Representative Ken Gordon is accepting applications for college level internships in his office during Summer 2025. Internships at the State House are unpaid. Any college student is welcome to apply. Applicants with a connection to Rep.
